ruled_out_vectors.vector: Malicious pool type returns inflated amountOut to drain cross-pool reserves via multi-hop
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Per-pool reserve accounting via _safeDecrementUint128 (AMMModule.sol:1437) prevents cross-pool drainage. Malicious pool can only decrement its own reserves. Balance check at L2208 validates actual token receipt. Attacker can only trade with their own deposited tokens.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Malicious transfer handler skips actual transfer
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Balance diff check at AMMModule.sol:2208 (balanceInBefore + amountIn == balanceInAfter) ensures handler MUST actually transfer tokens to AMM. Structural guard — no bypass path.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Direct hook invocation bypassing AMM (forged hook caller)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMStandardHook._requireCallerIsAMM() (line 940-943) validates msg.sender == AMM on all entry points: beforeSwap (L110), afterSwap (L159), validateAddLiquidity (L253), validatePoolCreation (L312). External callers rejected.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Storage-slot collision between extensions and core diamond storage
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All extensions (pool types, hooks, handlers) called via `call` not `delegatecall`. They execute in their own storage context. Only MODULE_LIQUIDITY/ADMIN/FEE_COLLECTION are delegatecalled via immutable constructor params.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Pool type address collision via CREATE2 mining
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: 6 leading zero bytes constraint = 2^112 possible addresses. Collision probability is negligible. Mining to match specific address infeasible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Diamond facet selector collision or unauthorized facet addition
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Not a diamond proxy with facet registry. Single EIP-1967 implementation with immutable module addresses set in constructor. No facet management functions.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: CREATE2 destroy and redeploy at trusted address
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Solidity 0.8.24 + Cancun EVM — selfdestruct deprecated. No CREATE2 redeploy attack vector.
SecureProxy is simple EIP-1967 proxy. Upgrade requires SECURE_PROXY_ADMIN_ROLE + Tier 4 pause. No unprotected initializer.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan cross-token fee denomination mismatch exploitation
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Token hook controls fee token (AMMModule.sol:3409). Only exploitable if token owner sets malicious hook (Tier B — self-inflicted). Fee token validation via FLASHLOANS_VALIDATE_FEE_FLAG provides defense for tokens that opt in.
FeeHelper.sol uses FullMath.mulDiv (rounds down against attacker for input fees) and mulDivRoundingUp (rounds up for LP fees). No dust accumulation profitable to attacker over gas costs.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Transient-slot theft (stale slot from prior operation in same tx)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Known Low finding CP-001/HOOK-001. Transient slot written in beforeSwap, read in afterSwap for direct swaps. By-design overwrite. No new extraction path beyond known finding.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Permit mutation with unsigned feeOnTop field
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Known Low finding. feeOnTop not in SWAP_TYPEHASH but limitAmount IS signed and caps total exposure. No extraction beyond limitAmount cap.
Known finding CP-003/v1-L01. computeRatioX96 returns 0 on overflow, bypasses max bound when min bound unset. Already documented.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Malicious hook fee inflation to steal from swappers
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Hook fees bounded by swap amount (AMMModule.sol:2616 — feeAmount > swapAmountIn reverts). Hook fees go to hook's stored address. Token owner controls hook = self-inflicted risk for token holders who chose that token.
poolFeeBPS from hook validated <= MAX_BPS (AMMModule.sol:1717). Cannot exceed 100%. Pool hook address stored at pool creation time.
Reentrancy guard (TstorishReentrancyGuardWithFlags) active during swap execution. Handler callback at AMMModule.sol:2250-2251 occurs within the reentrancy guard scope.

theft_theses.thesis: Malicious pool type returns inflated amountOut to drain legitimate pools via multi-hop swap
Malicious transfer handler skips transfer, core credits funds without receipt
Direct hook invocation with forged pool identity to credit attacker without legitimate swap

forge_test.reason: no hypotheses survived to PoC stage — all ruled out via code analysis
